name: planned-add-refuses-existing
body: `apg plan add <project> planned <kind> <fqn> …` must refuse when the planned FQN is already declared in the plan, naming the entity and pointing at `apg plan update <project> planned <fqn>` or `apg plan rm`. Today `plan_add_planned_at` (src/plan_cmd.rs:342–402) calls `artifacts::remove_node(records, fqn)` (line 393) then re-appends — a silent upsert. Acceptance: re-declaring an existing planned FQN exits non-zero with no plan-file change.
